title: Uber is laying off 10% of staff, or 3,300 people
snippet: Uber is laying off about 3,300 people, or about 10% of its global headcount, in a bid to reduce management layers and invest more in its ride-sharing, delivery, and robotaxi divisions.

title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
snippet: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.
